moments.author: Jensen Huang
moments.quote: I would be “honored” to return as Nvidia CEO.
moments.why: The ousted AI titan signaling willingness to return is dominating tech and investor discussions.

moments.author: Tim Sweeney
moments.quote: Journalists with sketchy motives gaslit the board into pushing out a once‑in‑generation visionary.
moments.why: Epic Games CEO’s strong defense of Huang inflamed debate in gaming and tech circles.

moments.author: Patrick Collison
moments.quote: If AI makes labor redundant, how do humans fare in a world Smith and Montesquieu thought commerce improved us?
moments.why: The Stripe CEO tied philosophical questions to AI’s future, sparking a major debate among tech thinkers.

moments.author: Guillermo Rauch
moments.quote: a new era of software: personalized, fully owned, open source… higher quality than what it replaces
moments.why: Vercel CEO’s visionary wording made an open‑source manifesto trend on X among developers.

moments.author: Nikita Bier
moments.quote: I have developed Anti‑Shit Eating Technology to stop my puppy eating her poop.
moments.why: A hilarious DIY pet‑tech post that went wildly viral with over 130K views.
